painPoints.title: SS7 Network Obsolescence and Fraud Vulnerability
painPoints.description: Telecom Argentina's legacy SS7 infrastructure is increasingly vulnerable to IMSI catchers and international roaming fraud. Current NewNet SS7 deployment lacks advanced anomaly detection and real-time threat mitigation, exposing the carrier to revenue leakage estimated at 2-3% of roaming traffic and regulatory compliance risks in key partner markets.

painPoints.title: IMS Core Network Interoperability and SMS Interworking Gaps
painPoints.description: Legacy SMS interworking between IMS-native subscribers and circuit-switched networks creates message delivery failures and poor USSD experience. NewNet IMS implementation lacks seamless SIP-I integration with Argentina's domestic network partners, causing 4-6% SMS failure rates and subscriber complaints in rural deployments.

painPoints.title: LTE Signaling Capacity Planning and Diameter Bottlenecks
painPoints.description: Rapid LTE subscriber growth (18% YoY) is straining current Diameter signaling infrastructure. NewNet's next-gen signaling software lacks predictive scaling capabilities, resulting in periodic HSS/AAA timeouts during peak hours and degraded mobile data authentication performance affecting 2-3% of sessions.

opportunities.title: 5G Core Network Signaling Modernization with Next-Gen Software Suite
opportunities.description: Expand NewNet Communications next-gen signaling software to support 5G NSA/SA deployments and migrate from Diameter to 3GPP Service Based Architecture (SBA). Includes NFV-ready Signaling Function (SIF) modules, SIP-T/QSIG advanced call routing, and cloud-native Gx/Gy policy control. This positions Telecom Argentina to launch commercial 5G services by Q4 2025 with vendor-agnostic network architecture.

opportunities.title: Regional Roaming Hub and Enhanced SS7/SIP-I Gateway Services
opportunities.description: Leverage NewNet SS7 and advanced signaling capabilities to establish Argentina as a regional roaming hub for LATAM carriers. Deploy dedicated SIP-I interworking gateway, advanced fraud detection, and revenue assurance modules. Monetize through termination fees and B2B roaming intelligence services to 8-12 regional partners, projected to generate $450K-650K incremental ARR within 18 months.
